zhPrompt: 输出一张完整的写实照片，以真实相机拍摄的画面为目标，主体比例、材质、透视与光影符合物理规律；不附加海报标题、图表或拼贴版式
enPrompt: Deliver a single realistic photograph with camera-plausible subject proportions, materials, perspective, and light; no poster titles, charts, or collage layout

zhPrompt: 日常生活随拍，用自然生活中的瞬间记录主体，保留生活环境与真实细节，姿态放松，不刻意摆拍或布置广告场景
enPrompt: Everyday snapshot documenting a spontaneous moment, preserving lived-in surroundings and authentic details, relaxed rather than staged or advertising-oriented

zhPrompt: 旅行纪念照片，人物与当地地标或旅行环境同时清晰可辨，保留地点识别度和自然互动，避免背景被虚化到无法辨认
enPrompt: Travel keepsake photograph with both the person and the destination landmark or surroundings recognizable, natural interaction and a clear sense of place rather than an unrecognizably blurred background

zhPrompt: 用于简历、团队介绍或职业主页的形象照片，面部清楚、神态可信、着装符合职业身份，背景克制，保留自然皮肤和人物辨识度
enPrompt: Professional headshot for a resume, team profile, or professional page; clear face, approachable confident expression, role-appropriate attire, restrained background, natural skin and recognizable identity

zhPrompt: 家庭纪念合影，所有家庭成员面部可见、彼此关系亲切自然，合理安排前后站位与身高层次，避免成员遮挡或遗漏
enPrompt: Family keepsake group photograph with every family member visible, warm natural relationships, balanced heights and rows, no omitted members or obscured faces

zhPrompt: 婚礼纪念照片，围绕新人交流或仪式关键瞬间组织画面，清楚呈现神态、礼服和互动，保留婚礼现场环境，不做商业婚纱广告版式
enPrompt: Wedding keepsake photograph centered on the couple's interaction or a key ceremony moment, showing expressions, attire, and gestures clearly with the wedding setting intact, not a bridal advertising layout

zhPrompt: 毕业纪念合影，毕业生与校园或毕业仪式背景共同入镜，人物站位有序且面部清楚，学位服与纪念动作自然，不遗漏或复制人物
enPrompt: Graduation group photograph with graduates and a recognizable campus or ceremony setting, orderly placement, clear faces, natural graduation attire and gestures, no missing or duplicated people

zhPrompt: 儿童成长纪念照片，通过自然活动或身高参照记录成长阶段，衣着完整、姿态自然，保留真实儿童比例与安全日常环境，不成人化修饰
enPrompt: Childhood milestone photograph documenting growth through a natural activity or height reference, fully clothed, age-appropriate proportions and safe everyday surroundings, no adult styling

zhPrompt: 孕期纪念照片，通过舒适得体的完整衣着、自然体态与轻柔互动记录孕期，人物比例真实，肢体舒展，环境安静，不夸张修饰腹部
enPrompt: Maternity keepsake photograph with comfortable complete clothing, natural body shape and gentle interaction, realistic proportions and relaxed posture in a quiet setting, no exaggerated belly reshaping

zhPrompt: 宠物写真照片，围绕宠物的眼神、神态与个体特征构图，毛发细节自然、四肢结构合理，主体清楚且背景不抢视线
enPrompt: Pet portrait photograph centered on the animal's gaze, expression, and individual features, natural fur detail and correct limb anatomy, a clearly readable subject against an unobtrusive background

zhPrompt: 运动赛事抓拍，捕捉动作关键时刻与比赛关系，主体动作及比赛器材清晰、肢体结构正确，保留可辨认的赛场，不把动作凝固为棚拍摆姿
enPrompt: Sports event photograph capturing a decisive athletic moment and competition context, readable movement and equipment, correct anatomy and a recognizable venue, not a studio action pose

zhPrompt: 会议或公共活动现场记录照片，清晰交代主要参与者、观众与场地关系，捕捉真实交流或互动，保持现场布置与空间逻辑，不生成活动宣传海报
enPrompt: Conference or public event documentation photograph showing participants, audience, and venue relationships, a candid exchange or interaction, coherent staging and space, not an event promotion poster

zhPrompt: 自然风光摄影作品，以地貌与自然环境为主体，前中远景层次清楚，地平线与空间透视合理，保留真实天空和地形质感，不拼接无关景观
enPrompt: Landscape photograph centered on landforms and natural surroundings, legible foreground, middle distance and background, coherent horizon and perspective, plausible sky and terrain textures without unrelated landscape composites

zhPrompt: 城市人文街拍照片，以街头人物与公共空间的真实关系呈现生活瞬间，保留环境信息与叙事层次，不强行摆拍，不用海报文字替代画面叙事
enPrompt: Urban street photograph conveying a candid human moment through people's relationship with public space, contextual detail and narrative depth, no forced posing or poster text replacing visual storytelling

zhPrompt: 已建成建筑的实景记录照片，准确展示建筑外观、体量、材料与周边关系，立面垂直线稳定，避免凭空增加结构，不画成未建成项目效果图
enPrompt: Documentation photograph of an existing building, showing its exterior, massing, materials and surroundings faithfully, stable facade verticals, no invented structures or unbuilt-project visualization

zhPrompt: 用于房源介绍的室内实拍照片，交代房间格局、通行关系、采光与固定设施，保持真实空间尺度和垂直线，不夸大面积，不凭空重新装修
enPrompt: Property listing interior photograph showing room layout, circulation, daylight and fixed fixtures, truthful spatial scale and verticals, no exaggerated room size or invented renovation

zhPrompt: 野生动物生态摄影，动物保持物种形态、自然行为及栖息地关系，毛羽与环境细节真实，主体易辨识，不拟人化或摆成宠物棚拍
enPrompt: Wildlife documentary photograph with species-appropriate anatomy, natural behavior and habitat relationships, authentic fur or feather and environmental detail, a recognizable animal without anthropomorphism or pet-studio posing

zhPrompt: 植物图鉴记录照片，花、叶、茎及关键形态特征清晰可辨，颜色自然、结构准确，保留必要整体形态，不用艺术变形替代识别特征
enPrompt: Botanical record photograph clearly showing flowers, leaves, stems and diagnostic morphology, natural color and accurate structure, retaining enough of the whole plant for identification without artistic distortion

zhPrompt: 舞台演出记录照片，捕捉表演者与乐器或舞台动作的关系，面部与关键手势清楚，保留真实舞台灯光和现场层次，避免肢体、乐器变形
enPrompt: Stage performance photograph capturing the performer's relationship to an instrument or stage action, clear face and key gestures, authentic stage lighting and spatial depth, no distorted limbs or instruments

zhPrompt: 手工制作过程记录照片，突出双手、工具、材料与正在进行的工序之间的准确关系，保留工坊环境与真实制作痕迹，不做分解图或拼贴步骤图
enPrompt: Craft process documentation photograph emphasizing accurate relationships among hands, tools, materials and the work in progress, authentic workshop context and making marks, not an exploded view or a collaged step diagram

zhPrompt: 工业生产纪实照片，展示人员、设备和生产流程的合理关系，劳动防护与操作状态可信，空间尺度真实，不夸张添加虚构高科技界面
enPrompt: Industrial documentary photograph showing plausible relationships among workers, equipment and production activity, appropriate protective gear and credible operation, truthful scale, no invented futuristic interfaces

zhPrompt: 用于车辆介绍的实拍照片，车身轮廓、车轮和外观状态清楚，反光自然，保留完整车辆与接地关系，避免概念车改装、车身畸变或广告文字
enPrompt: Vehicle listing photograph showing the complete body, wheels and exterior condition clearly, natural reflections and ground contact, no concept redesign, body distortion or advertising text

zhPrompt: 藏品档案记录照片，完整展示器物轮廓、纹饰、材质和保存状态，背景中性、照明均匀，形状与色彩忠实，不修补真实岁月痕迹或做商业包装展示
enPrompt: Collection archive photograph showing the full object silhouette, ornament, material and preservation condition, neutral background and even illumination, faithful shape and color without repairing age marks or adding commercial packaging

zhPrompt: 物品状态记录照片，清晰呈现磨损、缺口或表面状态及其在物件上的位置，保留必要整体参照，光照客观，不美化修补，不捏造测量数值
enPrompt: Object condition documentation photograph clearly recording wear, chips or surface condition and their location on the object, enough whole-object context, objective lighting, no cosmetic repair or fabricated measurements
